scripts.dev: npm run build -w @artopus/shared && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @artopus/shared" "npm run dev -w @artopus/api" "npm run dev -w @artopus/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @artopus/shared && npm run dev -w @artopus/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @artopus/shared && npm run dev -w @artopus/api
scripts.seed:demo: npm run build -w @artopus/shared && npm run seed:demo -w @artopus/api
scripts.content:business: npm run build -w @artopus/shared && npm run content:business -w @artopus/api
